desc.en: Northland City lies on the bustling eastern coast of the Empire. It serves as a vital port and commercial hub of the realm, boasting a highly sophisticated transportation network. You may overlook the city’s layout from the express arterial bridges, or take a sightseeing ferry for a night cruise across the downtown district.
desc.zh: 诺斯兰德城坐落于帝国繁华的东海岸，是帝国至关重要的港口与商贸中心，拥有一套高度完善的交通网络。你可以从快速干线大桥上俯瞰整座城市的格局，或是搭乘观光渡轮，夜游市中心水域。
